Sana: Quick heads-up — planning a gradual rollout for search-autosuggest v2 starting today. Rough plan: canary -> 1% (15m) -> 5% (30m) -> 25% (45m) -> 100% if green. Need deploy owner, smoke lead, rollback ready. Target window 16:00-18:00 UTC. Who can own deploy?
Leo: I can own the deploy window. I'll be online from 15:30-18:30 UTC.
Jules: I'll take smoke. Will run search + embeddings sanity tests and post a checklist.
Marta: Which cohorts are we targeting for the early slices? Recommend NA-east + our internal beta tag.
Sana: Agreed — start with NA-east + users labeled "beta-2026" for 1% and 5%, then add EU-west at 25%.
Amit: Rollback plan: pin to previous image, disable prefix caching, and revert routing. I updated the rollback section in the runbook (link: https://go/runbooks/search-rollback).
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Leo: image redwood/search-autosuggest:v2 -> scheduled at 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z.
Leo: Jules — any ETA on smoke scripts? Also, can you publish the success criteria?
Jules: Checklist (short):
1) /health returns 200 from canary instances
2) run smoke set: ./scripts/smoke_search.sh --cohort beta-2026
3) 95p latency <= baseline * 1.4
4) error rate < 0.5% sustained over 5m
5) spot-check top-3 results for obvious regressions
I'll post logs into this thread as I run them.
Sana: Also monitor embedding cost — if token consumption spikes we hold and investigate.
Marta: I'll watch the infra alarms and the canary metric dashboards. If any alarm fires, call the hold.
Leo: Ramp schedule I'll follow unless we hit a hold: 16:00 -> 1% for 15m, 16:20 -> 5% for 40m, 17:00 -> 25% for 45m, 17:45 -> candidate to go 100% if green. Sound OK?
Amit: Add automated hold triggers: 95p latency increase > 40% OR error spike > 0.5% for 5 minutes -> auto-hold. Also manual hold allowed by any owner.
Jules: I'll publish a short command to run quick smoke locally: ```curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://canary-search.na-east.redwood/api/v1/query?q=coffee' | jq '.results[0:3]'```
Leo: Good. If we need rollback I'll execute: `kubectl set image deploy/search-api search=redwood/search-autosuggest:stable --record` and broadcast the rollout id here.
Sana: :thumbsup: Please ack if you're set. Post any risks.
Leo: Ack. I'll post a 15m pre-deploy reminder at 15:45 UTC.
Jules: Ack — I'll be ready to kick off smoke as soon as canary is up.
Marta: Ack — monitoring on standby.
Amit: Ack — rollback playbook ready.
deploy-bot: Canary start triggered by Leo at 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z. Canary ID: c-20260318-001.
Jules: Starting smoke now, posting live results...
Leo: Thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread updated with holds/rollback decisions.
